sections.title: Steel Above Market Movement
sections.body: Long Bien Market sits naturally in the same frame: produce, carts, and the older working edge of Hanoi.

sections.title: A Careful Bridge
sections.body: Stay on the permitted side, give bikes room, and treat the bridge as working infrastructure, not just a photo object.

entries.summary: Long Bien Market is crates, fruit, carts, quick hands, and wholesale movement near the bridge, not a polished souvenir browse after dark.
entries.context: Long Biên Market belongs to Hanoi before breakfast, when fruit crates, carts, bridge traffic, and wholesale movement make the city feel awake early.
entries.tip: Stand back before stepping in. The market has its own traffic, and the gaps can close quickly.
entries.rationale: Long Bien Market becomes specific through wholesale rhythm and its relationship to the bridge.

sections.title: Crates Before Souvenirs
sections.body: Long Bien Market is not a polished browsing market. It is crates, fruit, carts, quick hands, and wholesale movement near the bridge.

sections.title: Watch The Flow First
sections.body: Stand back for a minute before stepping in. People carry produce, sellers sort goods, and narrow gaps close quickly.

sections.title: Chợ Long Biên
sections.body: Chợ Long Biên is the local name. It belongs with produce, carts, bridge light, and the Red River edge.

sections.title: Small Cash, Small Buys
sections.body: A light browse respects the working market. Price, small purchase, and a quick step aside are enough.

sections.title: Bridge Light Nearby
sections.body: The bridge gives the market a stronger setting. Fruit crates and steel truss belong to the same older Hanoi edge.

sections.title: Working-Market Hours
sections.body: The market mood belongs to working traders, carts, produce, and the river edge. A light, observational visit fits best.

entries.summary: Manzi is a compact creative stop where framed work, quiet rooms, and a cafe table can sit in the same visit between louder streets.
entries.context: Manzi belongs to Hanoi's small creative-room culture, where art, conversation, and a cafe table can sit inside one quieter address.
entries.tip: Look at what is on view before deciding how long to stay. Small art spaces reward a lighter plan.
entries.rationale: Manzi is strongest when the room leads and the coffee stays secondary.

sections.title: Art Before Coffee
sections.body: Manzi is a small creative stop where framed work, quiet rooms, and a cafe table can sit in the same visit.

sections.title: The Room Leads
sections.body: Look at what is on view before deciding how long to stay. A small art space rewards attention more than a fixed agenda.

sections.title: Manzi
sections.body: Manzi is the name people are likely to recognize. Show the name on a map if pronunciation feels uncertain.

sections.title: One Show, One Drink
sections.body: The best pattern is simple: see the work, take a quiet table if available, and leave before the stop feels forced.

sections.title: Quiet Beats Long
sections.body: Manzi is strongest as a compact creative stop, not a whole afternoon plan.

sections.title: Programming Changes
sections.body: If the show is light or the room is full, the stop can stay gentle and short.

entries.summary: Miến lươn is a Hanoi noodle order built around contrast: slippery glass noodles, eel, herbs, broth or sauce, and sometimes crisp pieces.
entries.context: Miến lươn belongs to northern noodle comfort, with eel, glass noodles, herbs, and a choice between soup softness and crisp bite.
entries.tip: If the shop gives you a choice, decide whether you want the comfort of soup or the sharper bite of crisp eel.
entries.rationale: Miến lươn is memorable because the bite changes across noodles, eel, herbs, broth, and sauce.

sections.title: Contrast Leads The Bowl
sections.body: Miến lươn is built around contrast: slippery glass noodles, eel, herbs, broth or sauce, and sometimes crisp pieces.

sections.title: Crisp Or Brothy Changes The Bowl
sections.body: If the shop gives you a choice, soup feels softer while crisp eel brings sharper edges. Both belong to the same noodle comfort.

sections.title: Miến Lươn In The Bowl
sections.body: Miến lươn is the name to recognize. It points to eel with glass noodles, from soupy bowls to drier versions.

sections.title: Herbs Change The Finish
sections.body: Do not treat the herbs as decoration. Add them slowly, taste the broth or sauce, then adjust.

sections.title: One Bowl Is Enough
sections.body: This is a good single-stop food memory. Order one bowl, understand the contrast, then leave room for coffee or another snack.

sections.title: Dish Variation
sections.body: Different shops can lean crisp, brothy, or saucy. The name gives the starting point, not the whole bowl.

entries.summary: Mien Luon Chan Cam is a focused Hanoi noodle stop: eel, glass noodles, herbs, steam, and a small-shop rhythm at the table for lunch.
entries.context: Chân Cầm gives miến lươn a specific Old Quarter address, where eel, glass noodles, herbs, and steam become a focused small-shop meal.
entries.tip: Knowing the bowl helps before the room starts moving. If unsure, a nearby bowl can make the order clear.
entries.rationale: Mien Luon Chan Cam is strongest when the bowl, not the schedule around it, sets the pace.

sections.title: The Bowl Sets The Pace
sections.body: Mien Luon Chan Cam is a focused Hanoi noodle stop: eel, glass noodles, herbs, steam, and a small-shop rhythm.

sections.title: Order Before The Room Moves
sections.body: Noodle shops feel easier when you decide quickly: bowl style, herbs, and whether you want anything extra.

sections.title: Miến Lươn Chân Cầm
sections.body: Miến lươn Chân Cầm is the name to show for the shop. It keeps the dish and street name together.

sections.title: Herbs, Glass Noodles, Eel
sections.body: The pleasure is texture more than size: noodles slip, eel adds chew or crispness, and herbs lighten the bowl.

sections.title: Quick Meal, Clear Stop
sections.body: This does not need to become a long dinner. It can be one sharp food memory in an old-lane day.

sections.title: The Bowl Is Enough
sections.body: A sharp stop is enough here: order, eat, pay, and carry the eel-noodle texture into the next street.
